title: Speech demo
description: Hands-on smoke test for the TTS + STT pipelines (US-160).

data.markdown:
## What this lesson checks

AI Lecturer ships with two optional speech components:

- **Text-to-speech (TTS)** — powered by Coqui XTTS. The lesson generator uses it to synthesise narration for AudioPlayer and TranscriptCloze sections.
- **Speech-to-text (STT)** — powered by whisper.cpp. Used by the SttDemo widget to transcribe a short clip you record from the microphone.

Neither is required to use the rest of the app, but both unlock richer demos. This lesson exercises the **STT** path end-to-end below.

:::callout{type="info" title="Setup hints"}
If the widget reports `stt-not-installed`, run `scripts/setup-stt.sh` from the repo root to install whisper.cpp + the default English model.
:::

> Click **Start** in the recorder below, say a short sentence, then click **Stop**. The clip is uploaded to the local STT engine and the transcript is rendered inline.

data.prompt: Say a short sentence in English.
